source_attestation.note: Three distinct artifacts are pinned. Contract comparison, not byte equality, establishes route coverage.

deliberate_deltas: Wildcard CORS replaced by an exact allowlist.
Cost-bearing routes require authentication; clone also requires admin authorization, consent evidence, and idempotency.
GET routes reject other methods instead of accepting them accidentally.
Cloudflare fallback replaced by the private FORGE voice gateway and made explicit per request.
Provider and voice identifiers are not exposed in discovery responses or logs.
